notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic land cards in your library are Forests.
easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Avatar of Growth.
When the Avatar of Growth token enters, it triggers, causing each player to search their library for up to two basic land cards and put them onto the battefield. Search for a Forest and any other basic land.
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Avatar of Growth
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
